title: SKYX and Its Subsidiary Deako Will Supply 70,000 Units of Its Advanced & Smart Technologies Through 2027 to Stone Martin Home Community Builder Under Exclusive Agreement
body_markdown:
*Plug-and-Play Advanced and Smart Home Technologies Expected to Be Supplied to Stone Martin Communities in Alabama and Georgia*


*Third Builder Program Announced by SKYX Deako Since Its Merger Closed October 13, 2026, with Approximately 210,000 Units Across More Than 2,550 Homes*


MIAMI, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SKYX Platforms Corp. (NASDAQ: SKYX) (d/b/a SKYX Technologies) (the "Company" or "SKYX"), an award-winning, highly disruptive advanced smart home and AI platform technology company with over 120 U.S. and global pending and issued patents and with a mission to make homes and buildings advanced, safe and smart as the new standard, today announced that SKYX and its wholly owned subsidiary Deako expect to supply approximately 70,000 units of their advanced and smart home technologies to Stone Martin communities for more than 850 homes in Georgia and Alabama through 2027. The Company has also extended its exclusive agreement with the developer through 2029.


Stone Martin Builders is a prominent Southeast homebuilder that has been developing communities across Alabama and Georgia for over 20 years.


From resort-style pools and clubhouses to winding nature trails, lakeside views, playgrounds and pavilions, Stone Martin communities are designed to bring neighbors together. Every home pairs that lifestyle with Deako smart home and lighting, a full smart home package, energy-efficient spray foam insulation and personalized design selections, all backed by a 10-year structural warranty.


**SKYX-Deako Homebuilder and Merger Highlights**


- Stone Martin is the third homebuilder program SKYX and Deako have announced since the merger closed on October 13, 2026.
- Since the October 13, 2026, merger close, SKYX and Deako have announced three builder programs with approximately 210,000 units expected for more than 2,550 homes.
- Stone Martin Builders: Approximately 70,000 units expected for more than 850 homes in Georgia and Alabama.
- Home Creations: Approximately 60,000 units expected for more than 700 homes in Oklahoma and Texas.
- Maronda Homes: Approximately 80,000 units expected for more than 1,000 homes.
- The SKYX Deako combined pipeline of potential future orders estimated at approximately 4 million units, with an expected average selling price of approximately $50 per product.
- Deako has shipped more than 32 million units, generated over $26 million in 2025 revenue and established relationships with more than 50 U.S. homebuilders, including D.R. Horton and Toll Brothers.
- The combined SKYX-Deako portfolio is designed to provide an end-to-end smart home offering for the builder and hospitality markets.
- Management believes the combined product portfolio could increase future revenue per home by up to five times; the merger is expected to reduce annual cash expenses by more than $6 million.

Derek Richardson, Founder and CEO of Deako, stated: "We are proud to grow our partnership with Stone Martin. They lead by making upgraded smart home technology standard in every home, which reflects how thoughtfully they build for their homebuyers. As our technologies are plug-and-play, home buyers can easily add products, including future products and upgrades, over the life of the home."


Rani Kohen, Founder and Executive Chairman of SKYX Platforms, said: "Working with a community developer such as Stone Martin is another important step in expanding our presence in the U.S. homebuilder market. In the four weeks since we closed our merger with Deako, we have announced three builder programs covering more than 2,550 homes, demonstrating our value proposition for the builder segment. We believe our combined plug-and-play technologies position us to bring safer, more advanced, and smarter solutions to a growing number of homes and buildings, and we expect to continue expanding our builder programs."


**About SKYX Platforms Corp.**


SKYX Platforms Corp. (NASDAQ: SKYX) is an advanced smart home, artificial intelligence (AI), and plug-and-play technology platform company with a mission to make homes and buildings safe, advanced, and smart as the new standard. Following its merger with Deako, Inc., SKYX combines complementary technologies designed to simplify the installation, integration, and upgrading of smart home and building systems across residential, commercial, builder, and hospitality markets.


The combined company offers a broad portfolio of plug-and-play platform technologies and products spanning ceiling and wall electrical infrastructure, intelligent lighting and switches, smart home and AI-enabled solutions, and other connected home and building applications. By bringing together SKYX's ceiling-based technologies and Deako's established wall-switch platform, the company enables a more comprehensive approach to smart homes and buildings, reducing the complexity associated with traditional wired installations while enhancing convenience, safety, and functionality.


SKYX has a combined portfolio of more than 120 issued and pending U.S. and international patents and patent applications relating to smart home and building platforms, AI, and plug-and-play technologies. Including its wholly owned subsidiary, Deako, SKYX supplies plug-and-play smart lighting technologies to more than 50 U.S. homebuilders and builders. The merger expands SKYX's opportunities across the homebuilder, professional, commercial, and hospitality markets, while creating potential for future recurring revenue through product upgrades and interchangeability, AI-enabled services, monitoring, subscriptions, and licensing.


In addition to its technology platforms, SKYX owns a portfolio of 60 lighting and home décor websites serving retail and commercial customers. Through its combined technologies and product portfolio, SKYX is focused on advancing the adoption of smart, connected, and safer environments in homes and buildings across the United States and internationally.


For more information, please visit[www.skyx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=rW9CXP9WJjXrpzNrbCTSWrysdtO7V4SFHwXO229UWMKs2q4A0YbbyPpEQYhJNK4v1NuXU74-rMygj9yLpiYkww==) and[www.deako.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dnhJVMH65UQK1TPxP89wURzqhxTf3bFGWoelTOXiIXVMDUzvFHW4aog4ADzDfX2evu27RSReHk0CsJYceo3ldw==) .
